description: This file defines an enumeration OutputFormat with cases for text and subtitle formats, including associated methods for formatting transcript data into respective output formats, considering time ranges for subtitles.

methods.name: needsAudioTimeRange
methods.description: Determines if the format requires audio time ranges (only SRT).

methods.name: text
methods.description: Returns the formatted transcript text based on the selected output format; for SRT, it formats timestamps and sentences with time ranges.
